name: Stegosaurus
section: Appendix D, Monsters and NPCs, Stegosaurus
errataEvidence: The official Tomb of Annihilation errata v2.0 does not change the Stegosaurus rules.
appearanceEvidence: The heavy frame, rows of plates and high flexible spiked tail come from printed p. 231. Color and the exact plates shown are editorial.
habitatEvidence: The Jungle columns of the Wilderness Encounters table on printed p. 194 list Stegosaurus. The printed p. 231 description notes mixed-age herds.
mechanicsNotes: Stegosaurus has a single Tail action. The adjacent Stone Juggernaut block supplies its own Devastating Roll and Slam.

name: Velociraptor
section: Appendix D, Monsters and NPCs, Velociraptor
errataEvidence: The official Tomb of Annihilation errata v2.0 does not change the Velociraptor rules.
appearanceEvidence: Printed p. 235 describes a feathered dinosaur about the size of a large turkey. The mottled tan feathers and colors follow the reused portrait.
habitatEvidence: The Wilderness Encounters table on printed p. 194 lists Velociraptor in beach, jungle and ruin columns. Pages 198–199 describe a pack ambush.
mechanicsNotes: The Appendix B Velociraptor encounter continues from printed p. 198 onto p. 199. The appended group check is scenario procedure. The basis for the main stat block is Appendix D p. 235.

name: Wild Dog
section: Chapter 3, Dwellers of the Forbidden City, 2. Walled Compound
errataEvidence: The official Tomb of Annihilation errata v2.0 does not change the Wild Dog rules.
appearanceEvidence: The adventure names wild dogs and uses Jackal statistics. It does not describe their phenotype. The original portrait takes visual cues from African painted dogs.
habitatEvidence: Printed p. 96 places six wild dogs in the Walled Compound in Omu. Open woodland is an editorial placement.
mechanicsNotes: Wild Dog is the Tomb of Annihilation encounter label. The adventure uses the Jackal block, with no standalone Wild Dog stat changes.

reskinReference.name: Jackal
reskinReference.sourceNotes: The Walled Compound encounter explicitly directs use of Jackal statistics. The printed Jackal block is on p. 331. No applied errata.

name: Zebra
section: Chapter 3, Dwellers of the Forbidden City, Wongo’s Shrine, areas 12B–12C
errataEvidence: The official Tomb of Annihilation errata v2.0 does not change the Zebra rules.
appearanceEvidence: The encounter calls the form a zebra. The striped coat, upright mane and tufted tail are editorial portrait details.
habitatEvidence: Savanna and open grassland are editorial habitats for an ordinary zebra. Wongo’s Shrine introduces it as a form from the mask curse.
mechanicsNotes: The scenario curse belongs to Wongo’s Shrine areas 12B–12C. The Zebra inherits the 2014 Riding Horse block.

reskinReference.name: Riding Horse
reskinReference.sourceNotes: The adventure explicitly assigns the Riding Horse statistics. The first print p. 336 gives Hooves +2. Wizards of the Coast errata v1.2 ©2016 already corrects it to +5, and v2.0 repeats the correction.
